title: 101 Zen Stories, Part 1: Japanese Zen Stories
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of this Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of embracing imperfection, acceptance, and letting go of ego in spiritual practice. Through stories from Nyogen Senzaki's book "101 Zen Stories" and personal anecdotes, Nomon Tim Burnett highlights the value of humility, patience, and understanding in achieving enlightenment. By sharing relatable tales that illustrate the human side of Zen, Nomon aims to make the dharma more accessible and relevant to everyday life.
